descriptor: Broadband that helps you fix it yourself

voice.summary: Sounds like a calm engineer on the phone: asks one question at a time, never makes you feel silly. Steps are short and numbered.
dos: Ask one yes or no question at a time
Describe lights and cables by what you can see
Say how long each fix takes
donts: No jargon like DHCP or latency
No more than three sentences per step

taglines: Fix it in a few questions
Help that starts with a question
boilerplate: brightwire is a broadband provider whose help centre walks customers through a simple yes or no flowchart to fix the router themselves, with an engineer on hand if not.

microcopy.error: That did not fix it, let's try the next step
microcopy.empty: You have not answered any questions yet

logo.note: A wave line looks like a signal and keeps the lowercase wordmark friendly.
